source.title: <UNUSED>
source.description:
Throm-ka, <class>. There is no time to waste. Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have fortified themselves in the valley to the south of here.

They have denied the Warchief's mandate, leaving us only one course of action. We will eliminate them so that they will no longer dirty the name of the Horde.

        See if you've already completed this by typing:

        /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(242))
source.objective: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Raiders, 3 Dragonmaw Bonewarders, and a Dragonmaw Battlemaster.
